samples.summary: `NotesView.showAuthors` fallback is now dead, and the comment the diff rewrites names a consumer that does not exist
samples.evidence: The diff rewrites the `showAuthors` doc to say the stored-preference fallback is "kept for a mount that owns no view menu (the revision preview)". The revision preview does not mount `NotesView` at all — `packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:759` calls `initializeNote(container, new MemNoteStore(text), theme, true, 'view')` directly. After this change both real `NotesView` call sites pass `showAuthors` explicitly (`packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-detail.tsx:323` and the new `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-notes-layout.tsx:121`), so `showAuthors ?? storedShowAuthors` (notes-view.tsx:110) and the `readShowAuthors` read at notes-view.tsx:109 can never take the fallback branch. The prop/comment now describe a contract no caller uses.

samples.summary: The docs package still asserts the exact "client wrapper is the write boundary in shadow mode" claim this change repudiates
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts:38-42` states "the Yorkie auth webhook ... ships in shadow mode by default ... so with the default configuration this flag is the write boundary rather than a convenience in front of one", and `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:4411-4415` repeats it ("in a stock deployment this is the write boundary for a viewer share token"). The new `packages/notes/src/store/read-only.ts` explicitly records that claim as *wrong* (a viewer not running our code reaches Yorkie directly), and `docs/design/notes/notes.md:306` records it as wrong too. The sibling module a reader is pointed at now contradicts the corrected reasoning; the two docs-package comments were not updated with it.

samples.summary: `shareTokenImageUploader` rejects on failure, but the notes `UploadImage` contract expects a reported-and-null result, so a share-link editor's failed upload is silent
samples.evidence: `shareTokenImageUploader` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.ts:40-49) throws/rejects on a failed `postShareTokenImage`. The notes engine's `UploadImage` contract is "resolve with the URL, or `null` if the upload failed **and was already reported to the user**" (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-view.tsx:47-51), and the engine swallows a rejection with only `console.error('Image upload failed', err)` (packages/notes/src/view/image-upload.ts:179-190). The workspace route satisfies the contract by catching and toasting (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-detail.tsx:203-220); this new share-link call site does not, so an anonymous editor's failed paste/drop just makes the placeholder vanish with nothing shown.

samples.summary: Unused `export default SharedNotesLayout` alongside the named export
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:1002` and the new test both import the named `SharedNotesLayout`; nothing imports the default. Grep for `shared-notes-layout` found only those two named importers, so the default export is dead (knip's unused-exports lane may also flag it).
